info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Background Transfers API

items.docs: Retrieves the list of active and pending background download operations using BackgroundDownloader.GetCurrentDownloadsAsync.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Create a background download

items.docs: Creates a background download operation using BackgroundDownloader. Background transfers continue even when the app is suspended and support progress tracking, pause/resume, and cost-aware transfers.
